explore_prose: Every run in this experiment is in the explorer below: filter by outcome to see which settings held the SLOs, or by setting to compare one sweep against another.
Each sweep's hypothesis was written before the runs, and is quoted beside that sweep's measured result below.

hero.html: 86 configurations over 6 sweeps (topology-ep, batch-prefill, kv-capacity, moe-collective, cudagraph, routing), each at 4 load levels, every run on exactly 512 GPUs.

64x TP8 + EP (batch tokens 32,768 · KV dtype fp8), from the kv-capacity sweep, reached 46.27 tok/s/accelerator (23689.1 tok/s across the fleet) at concurrency 256 while holding the scenario's SLOs. Ranking: max output tok/s per accelerator subject to the scenario's SLOs.
64x TP8 + EP (batch tokens 32,768 · KV dtype fp8) at concurrency 256. 119 of 344 runs held the SLOs.

meta: deterministic sweep — no LLM in the measurement path
scope: cluster; worst instance for TTFT and end-to-end gates
recommendation_prose: The table below lists the measured operating points. Headline ranking: max output tok/s per accelerator subject to the scenario's SLOs. The Pareto front of every sweep is in pareto.json.

prose: Expert parallelism should win at every width, and wider tp should beat wider dp on 10k-token prompts.
Measured: best was 64x TP8 + EP at 44.04 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 256).
sections.title: Sweep: topology-ep

prose: The per-step token cap should set ITL, and chunking long prefills should trade throughput for ITL below it.
Measured: best was 64x TP8 + EP (batch tokens 8,192) at 44.15 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 256).
sections.title: Sweep: batch-prefill

prose: fp8 KV should pay most where many resident 10k-token sequences make KV the binding resource.
Measured: best was 64x TP8 + EP (batch tokens 32,768 · KV dtype fp8) at 46.27 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 256).
sections.title: Sweep: kv-capacity

prose: The all2all gap should widen with EP width and per-step tokens, since 10k prompts push heavy dispatch volume.
Measured: best was 64x TP8 + EP at 44.15 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 256).
sections.title: Sweep: moe-collective

prose: PIECEWISE should trail the default capture mode and NONE should lose heavily, by a similar margin at both fleet ends.
Measured: best was 64x TP8 + EP (graph capture piecewise) at 42.41 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 256).
sections.title: Sweep: cudagraph

prose: Load- and KV-aware routing should beat random by more on 64 instances than on 8, as long prompts land unevenly.
Measured: best was 64x TP8 + EP (queue-kv routing) at 44.04 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 256).
sections.title: Sweep: routing
